instruction: Configure Chrome to use a minimum font size of 14 pixels to prevent text from being too small.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Chrome minimum font size to 14px. Custom getter extracts minimum_font_size from Chrome webkit preferences. Custom metric compares the integer value. Task complexity matches original - navigate to Chrome settings and adjust a font preference.
metadata.verification: Getter reads Chrome preferences file webkit.webprefs.minimum_font_size field. Metric compares integer values. Default Chrome minimum font size is 0 (no minimum), task changes it to 14px.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts minimum font size from Chrome preferences file at webkit.webprefs.minimum_font_size
Metric correctly compares integer result against expected size value of 14
Expected value (14 pixels) matches instruction requirement exactly
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preferences file reflects saved settings
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the single instruction requirement
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('size')
Edge cases handled: getter returns 0 as default, metric has error handling for type conversions
Data flow is logically correct: getter extracts int → metric compares int → returns binary score
